About Us

Specialised engineering and technical support services for the real sector of the Nigerian economy.

Who We Are

A trusted engineering partner

Folybim Engineering Nigeria Limited is unique in its willingness and ability to contribute to the development of the real sector of the Nigerian economy.

We provide specialised support services to engineering, telecommunications, oil and gas, manufacturing, finance and allied companies. Our team combines engineering expertise with sound business management to deliver dependable results.

Folybim Engineering Company Nigeria Limited is headquartered at Suite 25, Oja Oba Shopping Complex, Abule-Egba, Lagos. We serve engineering, telecommunications, oil and gas, manufacturing, finance and allied companies, combining technical expertise with a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. We hold a COREN certification and a Certificate of Incorporation, positioning us as a technically capable and professionally reliable contractor for public and private sector projects.

Mission & Vision

What drives us

Our Mission

To constantly improve the quality of the service we provide in order to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction and loyalty.

Our Vision

To pursue excellence in all its ramifications by providing excellent technical and consulting services to key players in the Nigerian economy, creating a wide range of employment and skills acquisition opportunities.

Our Values

The principles behind our work

Innovation

We push the boundaries with the latest technologies to deliver forward-thinking engineering solutions.

Quality

Excellence is at the heart of everything we do — from design through to handover and beyond.

Sustainability

We champion eco-friendly practices in every project, promoting renewable energy adoption and efficient design.

Customer Focus

Your needs drive our solutions. We tailor every engagement to your unique operating environment.

Integrity

Credentials

Registration & Certifications

Folybim Engineering Nigeria Limited is a registered Nigerian company operating in line with the relevant professional and regulatory standards.

Corporate Affairs Commission

Folybim Engineering Company Nigeria Limited — registered under the Companies and Allied Matters Act. Certificate of Incorporation & Memorandum and Articles of Association held.

COREN Certified

The Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) has certified Folybim Engineering, confirming our compliance with national engineering practice standards.

Quality & Safety Standards

Our operations follow rigorous health, safety and risk management procedures: hazard identification, mandatory PPE, continuous site supervision, and incident prevention culture.
